purpose: Connect one verified audience problem to the product's primary value proposition.
whenToUse: The input identifies a concrete primary problem
The product can visibly demonstrate a simpler or better path
whenNotToUse: The scene would require fear-based or unverifiable claims
requiredInputs: an evidenced product or workflow visual

layoutContract.comparison: Give both states equal visual weight until the solution is introduced.
layoutContract.density: Show one problem and one response only.

motionContract.entrance: Establish the problem, then transform or replace it with the product-supported solution.
motionContract.continuity: Use a shared object, line, or crop to make the causal relationship legible.

transitionOptions.use: Separate before and solution states with directional continuity.
Reveal the product response over the established problem.

captionRules.copy: State the problem plainly; do not exaggerate harm or promise certainty.
captionRules.placement: Keep captions outside the before/solution comparison axis.

fallbacks.condition: no visual proof of the old workflow
fallbacks.action: Use a neutral diagram built from the verified primary-problem wording.
Use a branded value-proposition card and record the missing evidence.

qaRules: Problem and solution are distinguishable without narration
Exactly one primary problem is presented
The solution language maps to a verified product fact
